requiredFindings.resolution: PREPARED-V3-WIRE-LIMIT runs for every non-rejected owner outcome, the defaulted partial-stale fallback-non-prepared included, and judges the rows the PreparedOutputManifest actually carries: every row of the Plan-bound set (PREPARED-V3-ENTRY, PREPARED-V3-SET-JOIN), a superset of the owner usable rows, so the carried bound implies the usable-row bound (wireLimitBasis publishes carried rows and the owner partition usable+stale+failed). Explicit over-limit refuses; defaulted over-limit is not selected: fallback-non-prepared, zero usable rows, owner staleRows kept, wireLimitDisclosure. Precedence published: prepared path refusal (before the owner, every row) > owner non-inert > owner stale-explicit > wire limit. The planner refuses manifests over maxSnapshotEntries, maxDependencySourceEntries and maxPreparedOutputEntries (entries:<Manifest>). Vectors cover stale/non-inert/failed/invalid-path/over-limit combinations in both modes, 257 carried rows with 256 usable, and the 299-entry plan.

The ECMA interpretation is restricted to a closed scope of (document, consumer) pairs: evidence schema / native model, evidence schema copy / startup model, occupancy companion / wire model, relation-payload schema / identity-model.v3 validate_registered_record. No canonical module or ExactValidator class is patched: in each scoped module only the name C is rebound to a view that evaluates marked pattern nodes as ECMA and delegates every other node to that module's pinned evaluation; marks are added only to the scoped document objects. Executed: each scoped consumer changes as declared and pinned differs; only scoped instances carry the view; only scoped documents are marked; canonical classes unchanged; identity v2 (NE.IM and identity-model.v3), identity v3, workflows common (validate_workflow), c2v3 and rust2 (every scoped canonical view) are unchanged on every review-04 changed example, each example shown to be a real ECMA/Python difference. The fact-plane owner check-fact-plane.py _is_path needs no change (no lookahead; it refuses control scalars). The unchanged list is corrected; controls in both directions.

relation-payload-schemas.v2.json CanonicalPath is a scoped row and parent (identity-model.v3 and its 11-document local registry closure pinned: 8 new pins). relationPayloadPathSites (FilePayloadV1.path, PackagePayloadV1.manifestPath, VcsChangePayloadV1.path, VcsChangePayloadV1.previousPath) is recomputed from the pinned document. RELATION-PAYLOAD-PATH-LAW vectors drive x<LF>/../y.rs, x<U+2028>/./y.rs and ../y.rs (refused REGISTERED_RECORD) and a/..<LF>, a<LF>b.rs (admitted) through validate_registered_record, the call retained fact admission registered_payload makes; the pinned model is shown to admit x<LF>/../y.rs at all four sites. A full admit_frame run over a retained Run bundle is not driven.

The plan carries cancelEcho; sender_ref.consume refuses a Cancel before the Hello slot (cancel-before-hello) and any Cancel that is not the exact CANCEL-NULLABILITY echo for its position with reason user-interrupt (cancel-echo). Vectors: before Hello (both majors), null echo after Hello, execution echo after OpenUniverse, full echo after Analyze, wrong same-length executionId, executionId before OpenUniverse, null executionId after it, wrong/null/early analysisOrdinal, wrong reason, same-type and same-chunk-coordinates payload-byte divergence. The sender echo law is executed against admission_ref cancel_nullability at every position of two plans. cancel-over-reserve, frame-limit and request-limit are stated defensive branches (unreachable for a plan consumed under its planning limits); the limit re-checks are exercised by consuming plans under lowered limits.
